# leavedesk

Leave requests for Quillmark staff, run from the command line and by the chat bot.

```
bin/leavedesk submit  --employee e-202 --type annual --from 2027-01-04 --to 2027-01-08 --reason "Skiing" --cover e-203
bin/leavedesk decline LV-0144 --by e-200 --note "Release week"
bin/leavedesk balance e-202
bin/leavedesk calendar --from 2026-12-01 --to 2026-12-31
ruby -Ilib -e 'Dir["test/*_test.rb"].each { |f| require_relative f }'
```

`--today` / `--now` pin the clock. Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` refused (`error: ...` on stderr),
`64` usage.

## Data (`$LEAVEDESK_DATA`, default `data/`)

- `employees.yml`: staff, their team, line manager and chat handle
- `requests.json`: every leave request; `days` is working days, computed by `Policy.working_days`
- `balances.json`: days left per employee and leave type, for types with an allowance
- `holidays.yml`: bank holidays

Leave types and their rules are in `lib/leavedesk/policy.rb`. A request is decided by the
employee's line manager or by anyone in the People team.

## Chat

`lib/leavedesk/chat.rb` posts cards to the channels in `config/channels.yml` and sends direct
messages. Cards are built by `lib/leavedesk/cards.rb`. There is no network here: every message
is written as it would be sent to `$CHAT_OUTBOX/<channel>/` or `$CHAT_OUTBOX/dm-<employee id>/`
(default `/var/tmp/chat-outbox`). `CHAT_FAIL=1` makes every post raise `ChatError`.

module Leavedesk
  class NotAllowed < StandardError; end

  # Submitting and deciding leave requests.
  module Requests
    module_function

    # Files a request and asks the employee's manager to decide it. The
    # manager gets the full card by direct message; #people-ops gets a copy.
    def submit(store, chat, employee_id:, type:, first_day:, last_day:, reason:, cover: nil,
               half_start: false, half_end: false, today:)
      employee = store.employee(employee_id)
      store.employee(cover) if cover
      first = Date.parse(first_day)
      last = Date.parse(last_day)
      days = Policy.check!(store, employee_id, type, first, last, today: today,
                                                                  half_start: half_start, half_end: half_end)
      request = {
        "id" => store.next_request_id, "employee" => employee_id, "type" => type,
        "first_day" => first.iso8601, "last_day" => last.iso8601, "half_start" => half_start,
        "half_end" => half_end, "days" => days, "reason" => reason.to_s.strip, "cover" => cover,
        "status" => "pending", "submitted_at" => today.iso8601
      }
      store.add_request(request)
      store.save
      card = Cards.leave_card(request, store, title: "Leave request from #{employee['name']}")
      manager = store.manager_of(employee_id)
      chat.direct(manager, card) if manager
      chat.post("people-ops", card)
      request
    end

    def ensure_decider!(store, request, by)
      decider = store.employee(by)
      return decider if store.manager_of(request["employee"])&.fetch("id") == by || store.people_team?(by)

      raise NotAllowed, "#{decider['name']} cannot decide #{request['id']}"
    end

    def ensure_pending!(request)
      return if request["status"] == "pending"

      raise NotAllowed, "#{request['id']} is already #{request['status']}"
    end

    # Declines a pending request and tells the employee.
    def decline(store, chat, request_id, by:, note:, now:)
      request = store.request(request_id)
      ensure_pending!(request)
      ensure_decider!(store, request, by)
      request.merge!("status" => "declined", "decided_by" => by, "decided_at" => now.utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
                     "decision_note" => note.to_s.strip)
      store.save
      employee = store.employee(request["employee"])
      chat.direct(employee, Cards.leave_card(request, store, title: "Your leave request was declined",
                                                             fields: %i[type dates days status approver],
                                                             footer: request["decision_note"]))
      request
    end
  end
end

require "json"
require "yaml"
require "date"

module Leavedesk
  class NotFound < StandardError; end

  # Employees, leave requests and balances, read from $LEAVEDESK_DATA.
  class Store
    attr_reader :dir, :employees, :requests, :balances

    def self.default_dir
      ENV.fetch("LEAVEDESK_DATA", File.expand_path("../../data", __dir__))
    end

    def initialize(dir = self.class.default_dir)
      @dir = dir
      @employees = YAML.safe_load_file(File.join(dir, "employees.yml")).to_h { |e| [e["id"], e] }
      @requests = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(dir, "requests.json"))).to_h { |r| [r["id"], r] }
      @balances = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(dir, "balances.json")))
    end

    def employee(id)
      @employees.fetch(id) { raise NotFound, "no such employee: #{id}" }
    end

    def request(id)
      @requests.fetch(id) { raise NotFound, "no such request: #{id}" }
    end

    def manager_of(employee_id)
      manager_id = employee(employee_id)["manager"]
      manager_id && employee(manager_id)
    end

    def people_team?(employee_id)
      employee(employee_id)["team"] == "People"
    end

    # Remaining days of a leave type for an employee, or nil for types
    # without an allowance.
    def balance(employee_id, type)
      @balances.dig(employee_id, type)
    end

    def adjust_balance(employee_id, type, delta)
      current = balance(employee_id, type)
      return if current.nil?

      @balances[employee_id][type] = (current + delta).round(1)
    end

    def next_request_id
      highest = @requests.keys.map { |id| id.delete_prefix("LV-").to_i }.max || 0
      format("LV-%04d", highest + 1)
    end

    def add_request(request)
      @requests[request["id"]] = request
    end

    def save
      write("requests.json", @requests.values.sort_by { |r| r["id"] })
      write("balances.json", @balances)
    end

    private

    def write(name, value)
      path = File.join(@dir, name)
      File.write("#{path}.tmp", JSON.pretty_generate(value) + "\n")
      File.rename("#{path}.tmp", path)
    end
  end
end

require "fileutils"

module Leavedesk
  class ChatError < StandardError; end

  # Posts cards to channels and direct messages on the company chat.
  #
  # There is no network in this image: every post is written, exactly as it
  # would be sent, to $CHAT_OUTBOX/<channel or dm-employee id>/NNNNN.json
  # (default /var/tmp/chat-outbox).
  class Chat
    def self.channels(dir = File.expand_path("../../config", __dir__))
      YAML.safe_load_file(File.join(dir, "channels.yml"))
    end

    def initialize(root: ENV.fetch("CHAT_OUTBOX", "/var/tmp/chat-outbox"), now: -> { Time.now.utc })
      @root = root
      @now = now
    end

    def post(channel, card)
      raise ChatError, "unknown channel ##{channel}" unless self.class.channels.key?(channel)

      deliver(channel, { "channel" => "##{channel}", "card" => card })
    end

    def direct(employee, card)
      deliver("dm-#{employee['id']}", { "to" => employee["chat_handle"], "card" => card })
    end

    private

    def deliver(box, message)
      raise ChatError, "chat is unavailable" if ENV.fetch("CHAT_FAIL", "") == "1"

      dir = File.join(@root, box)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
      seq = Dir.children(dir).size + 1
      record = message.merge("posted_at" => @now.call.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"))
      File.write(File.join(dir, format("%05d.json", seq)), JSON.pretty_generate(record) + "\n")
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "date"
require "yaml"

module Leavedesk
  class PolicyError < StandardError; end

  # Leave types and how many working days a request uses.
  module Policy
    TYPES = {
      "annual" => { allowance: true, notice_days: 14 },
      "medical" => { allowance: false, notice_days: 0 },
      "compassionate" => { allowance: false, notice_days: 0 },
      "parental" => { allowance: true, notice_days: 28 },
      "unpaid" => { allowance: false, notice_days: 14 }
    }.freeze

    module_function

    def holidays(dir)
      YAML.safe_load_file(File.join(dir, "holidays.yml"), permitted_classes: [Date]).map { |d| Date.parse(d.to_s) }
    end

    # Working days from first to last (inclusive), skipping weekends and bank
    # holidays. A half day at either end counts 0.5.
    def working_days(first, last, holidays, half_start: false, half_end: false)
      raise PolicyError, "leave ends before it starts" if last < first

      days = (first..last).count { |d| !d.saturday? && !d.sunday? && !holidays.include?(d) }
      days -= 0.5 if half_start && working?(first, holidays)
      days -= 0.5 if half_end && working?(last, holidays) && (last != first || !half_start)
      days.to_f
    end

    def working?(day, holidays)
      !day.saturday? && !day.sunday? && !holidays.include?(day)
    end

    # Checks a new request against the leave rules. Returns the working days.
    def check!(store, employee_id, type, first, last, today:, half_start: false, half_end: false)
      rule = TYPES.fetch(type) { raise PolicyError, "unknown leave type: #{type}" }
      days = working_days(first, last, holidays(store.dir), half_start: half_start, half_end: half_end)
      raise PolicyError, "request covers no working days" if days.zero?
      if (first - today).to_i < rule[:notice_days]
        raise PolicyError, "#{type} leave needs #{rule[:notice_days]} days' notice"
      end
      if rule[:allowance]
        left = store.balance(employee_id, type).to_f
        raise PolicyError, "not enough #{type} leave: #{days} requested, #{left} left" if days > left
      end
      overlapping = store.requests.values.find do |r|
        r["employee"] == employee_id && %w[pending approved].include?(r["status"]) &&
          Date.parse(r["first_day"]) <= last && Date.parse(r["last_day"]) >= first
      end
      raise PolicyError, "overlaps #{overlapping['id']}" if overlapping

      days
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "date"

module Leavedesk
  # Builds the chat cards leavedesk posts. A card is
  #   { "title" => String, "fields" => [{ "label" => String, "value" => String }], "footer" => String }
  module Cards
    DEFAULT_FIELDS = %i[employee team type dates days reason cover balance].freeze

    LABELS = {
      employee: "Employee", team: "Team", type: "Leave type", dates: "Dates", days: "Working days",
      reason: "Reason", cover: "Cover", balance: "Balance after", status: "Status", approver: "Approved by"
    }.freeze

    module_function

    # "Mon 7 Dec" or "Mon 7 Dec - Fri 11 Dec", with "(pm)" / "(am)" on half days.
    def format_dates(request)
      first = Date.parse(request["first_day"])
      last = Date.parse(request["last_day"])
      start = first.strftime("%a %-d %b") + (request["half_start"] ? " (pm)" : "")
      finish = last.strftime("%a %-d %b") + (request["half_end"] ? " (am)" : "")
      first == last ? start : "#{start} - #{finish}"
    end

    def format_days(days)
      (days % 1).zero? ? days.to_i.to_s : days.to_s
    end

    def field_value(name, request, store)
      employee = store.employee(request["employee"])
      case name
      when :employee then employee["name"]
      when :team then employee["team"]
      when :type then request["type"].capitalize
      when :dates then format_dates(request)
      when :days then format_days(request["days"])
      when :reason then request["reason"].to_s.empty? ? "-" : request["reason"]
      when :cover then request["cover"] ? store.employee(request["cover"])["name"] : "None arranged"
      when :balance
        left = store.balance(request["employee"], request["type"])
        left.nil? ? "n/a" : format_days(left)
      when :status then request["status"].capitalize
      when :approver then request["decided_by"] ? store.employee(request["decided_by"])["name"] : "-"
      else raise ArgumentError, "unknown card field #{name}"
      end
    end

    # A card about one leave request.
    def leave_card(request, store, title:, fields: DEFAULT_FIELDS, footer: nil)
      {
        "title" => title,
        "fields" => fields.map { |f| { "label" => LABELS.fetch(f), "value" => field_value(f, request, store) } },
        "footer" => footer || "leavedesk #{request['id']}"
      }
    end
  end
end
